run_training_worker: run the training worker to train and evaluate a transformer model on a length generalization task
create_uniform_curriculum: create a uniform curriculum that iterates over sequence lengths from 1 to the maximum training length
build_transformer_model: build a transformer encoder model with configurable layers, embedding dimension, and noisy relative positional encodings
test_length_generalization: test the model on length generalization tasks such as missing duplicate string with range test evaluation
run_training_with_flags: run the training script via argparse CLI with configurable batch size, sequence length, task, and architecture flags
